message.content:
**The Thinker (Le Penseur)** – Auguste Rodin (1880–1902)

Auguste Rodin’s bronze “The Thinker” is often regarded as the quintessential sculpture of the 19th‑century art world. Created in the early 1880s and cast in its final form in 1902, the work captured the era’s fascination with modernity, psychology, and the human condition. Its powerful, contemplative pose and the way it blends classical form with a distinctly contemporary sensibility made it an instant icon, and it remains one of the most reproduced and celebrated sculptures in history.
